programs.title: A Boyfriend To Die For
programs.desc: Olivia never wanted to be known as a product of nepotism, but as a rising star in her father's firm, that's exactly how people see her. Determined to prove herself, she meets Jonathan Rothfield.

programs.title: The Mother Flip
programs.desc: Rebecca and Kristy target a listing in Round Rock, a mini city in the Hill Country. They hit the ground running with money-saving ways to turn a tacky time capsule for taxidermy into a modern desert oasis.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael combines her favourite Reuben sandwich with America's summer favourite, hot dogs, to create a memorable meal served with fries.

programs.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
programs.desc: Marissa and Sean need more space. With a growing toddler and Sean working from home, they are busting at the seams. They want a house with a great view and coastal charm.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael prepares a traditional pollo al mattone, an Italian roast chicken, by seasoning spatchcock chickens, cooking them in a pan with a brick wrapped in tin foil, and serving them with sauteed greens.

programs.title: Global Soul Kitchen
programs.desc: Chef Deborah elevates the classic Jamaican beef patty by giving it a Southern twist and turning it into a delicious pot pie. This hearty and flavourful dish offers a vibrant journey to the Caribbean.
